## Definition of Done (ways-of-working §4)

- [ ] All acceptance criteria in the work item are met
- [ ] Tests written and passing; coverage ≥ 80% on `src/` (NFR-Q1)
- [ ] Lint and typecheck: 0 errors; CI green
- [ ] Every UI state covered: loading, error, empty, populated (FR-26)
- [ ] Matches the design screenshots attached to the work item (light + dark)
- [ ] a11y: axe 0 violations; keyboard + screen reader per AC
- [ ] No PII in URL, console, storage or logs (FR-31)
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour or setup changed
